props.html:
FEAST PASS

A reason to come back hungry.

Play, explore, complete quests, and collect treats as the web experience grows.

PLANNED

Your guest journey, made visible.

The beta direction centers on quests, treats, streaks, and levels. No fake XP, rewards, sync, or account balances are shown before those systems exist.

QUESTS

Little goals across the Feast

Point visitors toward games, characters, and stories.

TREATS

Collect something fun

A visible reward language for site progress.

STREAKS

Celebrate return visits

Encourage coming back without punishing missed days.
